description: #183: the anonymize wiped user picture columns to '' — the v2 avatar then rendered broken/empty — AND it entirely MISSED member_with_friend.picture_url, which kept 213 REAL external http photo URLs (residual PII in the test DB; the exact silent-miss class the email DO-block was built for, now proven a second time on pictures). Fix: replace (not wipe) all 5 user-facing picture columns (user.picture_url, user.share_img_profile_url, user_provider.picture_url, use_provider.picture_url, member_with_friend.picture_url) with a LOCAL placeholder '/images/v2/mascot/01.png' (served by the FE from public/, verified GET → 200 image/png 1456325B) — never external, never empty. Reference/engine image tables (card art, mascot, product, sacred-map temple photos) enumerated from information_schema and intentionally KEPT. Self-verify DO-block (inside the tx, before COMMIT): every one of the 5 columns must be 100% the placeholder — if a column has rows but is not entirely the placeholder (an external URL remains, OR it is 100% empty = the UPDATE never fired), the whole anonymize RAISES and rolls back. Teeth (applied to the real mumate_testenv_pg, path ข no re-dump): all 5 cols 100% placeholder, member_with_friend 213 external → 0, both DO-blocks passed → COMMIT. Neg-control: force one member_with_friend row back to an external URL → the DO-block WARNING pinpointed 2031/2032 + RAISE 'INCOMPLETE' → rolled back, DB still 2032/2032 placeholder (atomic, no damage). gate_layer=data/DB (in-tx self-verify).
